title: Content cross-linking and audience retargeting system
description:
## Problem

Content is fragmented across postmortems and blog posts with no systematic cross-referencing:

1. **Discovery gap**: Agents can't establish what's related or identify missing source files/blog posts
2. **Audience mismatch**: Technical postmortems vs. accessible blog posts serve different readers
3. **Context loss**: Neither humans nor agents can easily trace the full story across artifacts

## Proposed Solutions

### 1. Cross-linking infrastructure
- Add "Related" sections to all PMs referencing siblings
- Link blog posts back to source PMs
- Relationship graph in POSTMORTEM-INDEX.md
- Machine-readable metadata (YAML frontmatter?) for agent discovery

### 2. Content-cli evolution
- `content-cli relate <source> <target>` - establish bidirectional links
- `content-cli graph` - show relationship diagram
- `content-cli orphans` - find unlinked content
- `content-cli missing` - identify PMs without blog coverage

### 3. Audience retargeting
- `content-cli blog retarget <file> --audience [exec|technical|general]`
- Generate less technical versions from deep-dive postmortems
- Preserve source linkage (technical version → accessible version)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] All related PMs cross-referenced
- [ ] Blog posts link to source PMs
- [ ] Agents can discover related content programmatically
- [ ] content-cli supports retargeting workflow
- [ ] POSTMORTEM-INDEX has relationship section
